# Imarku

> > Imarku specializes in premium Japanese and German kitchen knives, knife sets, and cookware for home cooks, professional chefs, and gift-givers.

Imarku offers an extensive collection of high-quality kitchen cutlery featuring Japanese high-carbon stainless steel and forged designs. The site caters to diverse customer needs through curated collections for beginners, professionals, health-conscious cooks, and special occasions.

- Japanese Kitchen Knives

- Premium Cutlery

## Premium Knife Series

- [Artisan Series | Japanese High-Carbon Stainless Steel Kitchen Knives](https://imarku.net/collections/artisan-series): Premium Artisan series knives forged from Japanese high-carbon stainless steel at 56±2 HRC.
- [Kasumi Series | Japanese Hammered Knives](https://imarku.net/collections/kasumi-series): Hammered Kasumi series knives with multi-layered clad stainless steel and Tsuchime finish.
- [Katana Series | Premium Japanese Kitchen Knives](https://imarku.net/collections/katana-series): Hand-finished Katana series knives forged from high-carbon Japanese steel with traditional handles.
- [Sakura Series | Japanese Colorful Knife Sets & Knives](https://imarku.net/collections/sakura-series): Colorful Sakura series knives forged from Japanese high-carbon steel with ergonomic handles.
- [Xuanwu Series | Premium Japanese Knives for Home Chefs](https://imarku.net/collections/xuanwu-series): Xuanwu series knives with full-tang construction and high-temperature quenching for balance.
